title: HECM Loan Status: Due and Payable, Deferral, Reinstatement and Termination
content:
**Principle.** The servicing status of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) follows its maturity case and payoff case; the servicer never changes it on a caller's statement alone.

**Due and payable.** The loan is moved to due and payable only when a maturity case on the loan has reached due-and-payable status, and the loan's due-and-payable date is set to that case's due-and-payable date. Once due and payable, no draw or scheduled payment is made, per the plan's rule that draws stop at due and payable.

**Deferral period.** When the last surviving borrower dies and the loan names a non-borrowing spouse whose profile is an eligible non-borrowing spouse, who still occupies the home as principal residence, and the plan makes the deferral available, the loan enters the deferral period instead of due-and-payable status, with the deferral start date set to the date of death. The deferral period is entered only when the eligible non-borrowing spouse establishes a legal right to remain no later than the plan's legal-right period in calendar days after the last borrower's death. Those days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the date of death recorded on the maturity case, and the last counted day still qualifies. An ineligible non-borrowing spouse never qualifies for deferral, and a deferral loan becomes due and payable when its deferral-period case reaches due-and-payable status.

**Reinstatement.** A loan is reinstated to active only when its maturity case has reached cured status.

**Termination.** The loan is marked paid in full only when a payoff case on the loan has reached satisfied status under a payoff plan other than Approved Short Sale Payoff and Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure, and it is marked claim terminated only when such a case is satisfied under Approved Short Sale Payoff or Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure; the terminated date is the date the payoff case was satisfied.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical, 90-day period):** with the death recorded on day 0, the counted days run from day 1 to day 90. A legal right established on day 90 qualifies; one established on day 91 does not.

| Case on the loan | Loan status that follows |
|---|---|
| maturity case at due-and-payable status | due and payable |
| maturity case at cured status | active (reinstated) |
| payoff case satisfied, other payoff plan | paid in full |
| payoff case satisfied, Approved Short Sale Payoff or Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure | claim terminated |
